full_page.content:
1937, June
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 195 Cont.
June 19 Dr. Larry Kroha - 25 - in Provid. - very sick - transfusions yesterday and To-day.
Mrs. Nestor.
Page 196
June 23 Irvin Wochaski - 12 - infantile par. - oldest of six orphans - mother struggling
27 Eugiena St. Amour - 56 - mental trouble
27 Mrs. Nancy Miller - 66 - cancer-like intestines - Drs. give no hope of rec.
20 transfusions in 23 month : Philip Jos. Zerilli - 23 mo. - has had 10 transfusions. Bright little boy and happy till going to hospital. Then like all children he is scared.
Elaine McCurdy - 10 - infantile p. - two yrs. next Sept.
28 Beneditto Fontana - 11 shortly - heart ... born with a weak heart - is now 6 mo. very poorly - in hospital four months - sent home To-day as hopeless - i.e. June 30. Father promises to make "Easter duty"
Anthony Besetgki - 28 - very nerveous
Mrs. Minnie Panyard - 44 - ulcers uter. - very serious operation threatened. She has 7 children - 5 quite small.
Mary Ludwig ... no faith
Page 197 June 29 30 Bridie Blackwood - 48 - nerveous 30 Rose Lillian Shindorf - 6 - Spine injured, cannot talk, though understands. Enrolled To-day 50¢
August Carls - 53 - dropsey - very dangerous ... no sacraments
Michae Sheehy - 37 - cripple from birth - size of ten yrs. Mother died last month and no one wants to take care of him.
Carry Fraley - 49 - Goitre operation 2 yr ago. Another operation for adhesions and now - half dead - from spasims - asks for earnest prayers .. . .
